system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: prod-gke-net
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL

- name: prod-gke-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-gke-net.selfLink)
    region: us-central1
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/20
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    enableFlowLogs: true
    logConfig:
      aggregationInterval: INTERVAL_5_MIN
      flowSampling: 0.5
      metadata: INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA
    secondaryIpRanges:
    - rangeName: pods
      ipCidrRange: 10.20.0.0/14
    - rangeName: services
      ipCidrRange: 10.30.0.0/20

- name: prod-gke-router
  type: compute.v1.router
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-gke-net.selfLink)
    region: us-central1
    bgp:
      asn: 64514
    nats:
    - name: prod-gke-nat
      natIpAllocateOption: AUTO_ONLY
      sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
      subnetworks:
      - name: $(ref.prod-gke-subnet.selfLink)
        sourceIpRangesToNat:
        - ALL_IP_RANGES
        secondaryIpRangeNames:
        - pods
        - services
      enableEndpointIndependentMapping: true
      minPortsPerVm: 128
      logConfig:
        enable: true
        filter: ALL

- name: prod-gke-master-to-nodes
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    network: $(ref.prod-gke-net.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    targetTags:
    - gke-prod
    sourceRanges:
    - 172.16.0.0/28
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: tcp
      ports:
      - '443'
      - '10250'
    - IPProtocol: icmp

- name: prod-gke-cluster
  type: container.v1.cluster
  properties:
    zone: us-central1-b
    cluster:
      name: prod-gke-cluster
      network: $(ref.prod-gke-net.selfLink)
      subnetwork: $(ref.prod-gke-subnet.selfLink)
      releaseChannel:
        channel: STABLE
      addonsConfig:
        httpLoadBalancing:
          disabled: false
        horizontalPodAutoscaling:
          disabled: false
        networkPolicyConfig:
          disabled: false
      networkPolicy:
        provider: CALICO
        enabled: true
      legacyAbac:
        enabled: false
      ipAllocationPolicy:
        useIpAliases: true
        clusterSecondaryRangeName: pods
        servicesSecondaryRangeName: services
      privateClusterConfig:
        enablePrivateNodes: true
        enablePrivateEndpoint: true
        masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      shieldedNodes:
        enabled: true
      loggingService: logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      monitoringService: monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      defaultMaxPodsConstraint:
        maxPodsPerNode: 110
      nodePools:
      - name: prod-pool
        initialNodeCount: 3
        management:
          autoUpgrade: true
          autoRepair: true
        autoscaling:
          enabled: true
          minNodeCount: 3
          maxNodeCount: 10
        upgradeSettings:
          maxSurge: 1
          maxUnavailable: 0
        config:
          machineType: n2-standard-4
          imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
          diskSizeGb: 100
          diskType: pd-balanced
          metadata:
            disable-legacy-endpoints: "true"
          shieldedInstanceConfig:
            enableSecureBoot: true
            enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
          workloadMetadataConfig:
            mode: GKE_METADATA
          oauthScopes:
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/devstorage.read_only
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/logging.write
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/monitoring
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/service.management.readonly
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/servicecontrol
          - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/trace.append
          tags:
          - gke-prod
          labels:
            env: prod
